{
  "name": "fx0",
  "version": "0.0.10",
  "private": true,
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "typecheck": "next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental false",
    "start": "next start",
    "test:core": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/core.test.mjs tests/transcript.test.mjs tests/design-draft.test.mjs tests/design-publish.test.mjs tests/event-delivery.test.mjs tests/event-stream.test.mjs tests/public-fetch.test.mjs tests/remote-image.test.mjs tests/prompt-images.test.mjs tests/design-assets.test.mjs tests/runtime.test.mjs",
    "test:auth": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/auth.test.mjs tests/auth-callback.test.mjs tests/signout.test.mjs tests/ownership.test.mjs tests/history.test.mjs tests/route-security.test.mjs tests/gateway-session.test.mjs tests/libfx-transport.test.mjs tests/libfx-agent.test.mjs tests/auth-ui.test.mjs tests/html-ui.test.mjs tests/guest-ui.test.mjs tests/guest-draft.test.mjs tests/trial.test.mjs tests/turn-funding.test.mjs",
    "test:journal:integration": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --experimental-strip-types --test tests/journal.integration.mjs",
    "test:smoke": "node tests/local-auth-smoke.mjs",
    "db:migrate": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/migrate-database.mjs",
    "test:artifact:browser": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/design-artifact.browser.mjs tests/attach-image.browser.mjs",
    "test:budget:integration": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/turn-budget.integration.mjs",
    "test:turns:integration": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/turn-work.integration.mjs",
    "test:trial:integration": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/trial.integration.mjs",
    "test:credential:integration": "node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/turn-credential.integration.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@neondatabase/serverless": "^1.1.0",
    "@radix-ui/react-dialog": "^1.1.23",
    "@radix-ui/react-popover": "^1.1.23",
    "@radix-ui/react-scroll-area": "^1.2.18",
    "@radix-ui/react-tabs": "^1.1.21",
    "@radix-ui/react-tooltip": "^1.2.16",
    "@upstash/redis": "^1.38.4",
    "@vercel/blob": "^2.8.2",
    "botid": "^1.5.11",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "cn": "^0.5.0",
    "geist": "^1.7.2",
    "iron-session": "^9.0.1",
    "jose": "^6.2.12",
    "libfx": "0.0.14",
    "next": "^16.4.0",
    "next-themes": "^0.4.6",
    "react": "19.2.4",
    "react-dom": "19.2.4",
    "react-markdown": "^10.1.0",
    "remark-gfm": "^4.0.1"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": "24.x"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4.3.3",
    "@types/node": "^26.5.1",
    "@types/react": "^19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.3.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  }
}
